subject: prd/self-drive-wake
statement: When reporting a proposal landed, the state reader shall include the medium-reported landed revision identifier and shall present landing state as the medium's claim — a consumer performing verified advancement shall verify at the goal object per its own contract, and this reader's output shall carry what that verification needs.
rationale: a medium's "merged" certifies the medium's object, never the mainline (AP-26; incident I2); the reader must not launder a badge into goal-state
fit_criterion: the port's landed state carries the revision id on both adapters; a consumer-side fixture performs an ancestry check from the reader's output alone; the port docs mark landing state as medium-claimed
